findings.title: Locked solicitation narrows the field of action
findings.claim: In the enclosed scene, the woman's solicitation meets repeated bolting, controlled doors, and a direct summons, so desire is presented as a narrowing of Yusuf's available field of action.
findings.mechanism: The focus forms for solicitation, intensive closure, plural doors, and summons combine; the 12:24 formed-intention cue extends the same narrowing into an inwardly fixed demand.
findings.reader_payoff: The invitation becomes legible as arranged pressure on another will: the doors and the speech perform one operation together.
findings.containment: The ordinary solicitation and bolted-room scene remain intact. The holding field can also preserve integrity when Yusuf controls the boundary, and the 12:24 intention image is only a bounded contextual extension.

epistemic.reason: The trusted channel nomination lands its focus branches directly and the nominated formed-intention image in supplied 12:24; the synthesis remains an authored contextual inference.

findings.title: Purchased dependency becomes a claim on the self
findings.claim: The movement from hidden merchandise and cheap sale through household acquisition makes the focus solicitation read as an attempt to extend proprietary access from Yusuf's purchased status to his own self.
findings.mechanism: Merchandise, sale, diminished price, acquisition, household placement, and the public designation of dependent youth form a chain; meeting that chain with رَاوَدَتْهُ ... عَن نَّفْسِهِ turns a personal approach into a possible repetition of ownership logic across bodily access.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus's emphasis on Yusuf's own self becomes newly legible: the demand reaches a person already moved through exchange and unequal household dependency.
findings.containment: Before: the approach is a personal act of illicit attraction. After: it also attempts to treat a purchased dependent's self as another household asset available for use. A live alternative is genuine passion operating inside, but not because of, that ownership structure; the ordinary solicitation remains recoverable.

findings.containment: Before: the solicitation is followed by a separate false accusation. After: the focus identifies an intention that is seized, inverted, and reassigned before Yusuf's reply recovers agency and grammar. A live alternative is ordinary juridical phrasing without deliberate echo.
